RESULT [continual]: VOC 2007 19+1 (Table 1): fine-tune without distillation 26.4 mAP, frozen trunk 52.9, all layers frozen 66.6, distillation 67.8, joint 69.8. VOC 10+10 (Table 2): no distillation 38.7, EWC 46.3, distillation 63.1, joint 69.8.
US [continual]: This is the classic evidence that plain freezing of the trunk (52.9) and EWC (46.3) lose clearly to distillation, and that nothing beats joint training. It argues against making 'freeze the backbone' the default incremental policy without measuring it.
